statement: Let P be any finite set of distinct nonzero retained dual-lattice momentum classes modulo sign, with every doubled target [2p] retained but with source-target overlap P intersect 2P allowed. Define the zero-control Gaussian law once on P union 2P and use the R-128 fixed-law affine predictable controls h_[2p]=t_p H_p xi_[p], where each control reads its distinct raw source innovation. At the centered stationary common-even covariance-matched A1/A6/A7 law, fixed finite cutoff, positive floor, exact nonaliased torus integration, and the registered scalar regulator envelopes, injective doubling and raw-source independence make the source Gram diagonal and every distinct-source mixed covariance second jet zero. Factor-two source reuse adds no mixed covariance-normal endpoint edge or separate reverse payment; the complete mixed endpoint/loss Hessian retains only factor-three path edges. Exact R-130/R-151 envelopes, rational Sturm certificates, and an independent standard-library Fraction/Bernstein audit prove D2 A(0)[H,H] greater than (7/250) sum_p ||H_p||_HS^2 for every nonzero direction. A pure dyadic source family with no extra vertices has no factor-three edge and satisfies the sharper 147/1000 bound. The terminal sixth-power Hessian is retained and dropped only as one global positive-semidefinite form, not assigned the factor-three graph. A separately declared shifted-state p:2p:4p companion has one bilinear GH connection with support {+/-3p,+/-5p}; its endpoint and sextic first-variation connections vanish only at the declared all-zero stationary covariance-matched origin. This does not cover nonzero past, general nonlinear or revisit feedback, finite-amplitude convexity, aliasing, a genuine independent low/Feshbach coordinate, cutoff/floor removal, T-050 or A13 closure, Nelson, an interacting measure, any phase or PDE verdict, or Sector-A closure.
